record.title: Some ChatGPT content may be unavailable on Android

updates.body: We have identified an issue affecting the ChatGPT Android app where users may see “This content is unavailable in this version of the app” instead of certain content. A fix is rolling out gradually in the latest Android version. Users can use ChatGPT on the web while we work to restore the experience for older app versions.
All impacted services have now fully recovered.
